footnotes: MW: molecular weight; PI: isoelectric point; GRAVY: grand average of hydropathicity.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.caption: MIC of AOD and its derivatives.

tables.label: Table 3
tables.caption: Secondary structure proportions of AOD and its derivative peptides.

tables.label: Table 4
tables.caption: AOD in combination with antibiotics against S. epidermidis G-81.
footnotes: MICa: single agent MIC; MICc: combined agent MIC; TC: tetracycline; CIP: ciprofloxacin; CEF: ceftiofur; VAN: vancomycin. FICI = (MIC of drug A in combination)/(MIC of drug A alone) + (MIC of drug B in combination)/(MIC of drug B alone). FICI ≤ 0.5 indicates a synergistic effect, 0.5 < FICI ≤ 1 indicates an additive effect, 1 < FICI ≤ 4 indicates an irrelevant effect, and FICI > 4 indicates an antagonistic effect.
